en: feel free to shake him awake.
note: Continues #9874 ('If Mark is dozing,'), so lowercase.

en: That man is always dozing off.
Please do come by anytime.
Well, yes, that might be nice.
But not just yet.
Sorry, I was only strolling around and
thought I'd drop in for a moment.
Oh, that's quite all right.
After all, nobody has shoes made
all that often.
Are you new to the area?
I see.
I'm Sarah.
note: Follows #9931 'I see.' after a pause on the same line.

en: My husband Mark and I run this shoe
shop, as you can see.
When you want shoes made,
please do think of us.
, wasn't it?
How nice of you to come.
What kind of shoes would you like?
I'm sorry, not yet, not today
Oh my, of course.
My husband Mark makes some very fine
shoes now and then, you know.
Do give them a try sometime.
If you ever need shoes,
just let me know anytime.
Will you be having shoes made?
Have you decided to have shoes made?
You can count on us to make your shoes
Oh, I know! Why don't we talk away from the shop?
I'm sure we'd have a fun chat,
and you might even make up your mind
to order shoes from us, too.
'Shoes are a walker's best partner.'
That's how it goes.
We shoemakers make it our job to find
that best partner for people.
You who stand at my side
From now on, please
note: No used_in; assumed to continue into #9960.

en: work for me.
Humans
are fragile
, my master... Please, give me your orders...
note: Name + ', my master...' as in M2#0 / M2#994.

en: I haven't felt sleepy since I came to London.
Even when I sleep, I seem to do nothing but dream.
I've fallen out of bed, woken up on the
sofa... It's been one odd thing after another.
Excuse me, do you have a moment?
Is this the right way to the museum?
Yes, keep going this way and you'll get there.
Oh, good. Thank you so much.
It's not that I don't know where it is,
I'm just taking a different road today.
Thanks for telling me, you've been a help.
I'm Anna. I'm studying art.
I came to London to see the sights.
I see. I hope you enjoy your trip.
Well then, I'll be on my way.
London has so much to see. It's such fun.
? Is that you?
note: After the name: '{NAME}? Is that you?'

en: Yes, it is! I'm so glad I ran into you.
Thank you for the other day.
I know London's streets much better now.
I've walked all over the place.
Though I got lost plenty of times.
We meet again. How have you been?
I've fallen in love with the museum.
I'm there all day long.
Oh, good evening. Excuse me a moment.
Is there a museum near here?
Or is that biggest one the only one?
Hmm, I believe that may be the only one.
To be honest, I'm no expert myself.
Oh, I thought so. What a shame.
Then maybe next week I'll tour the galleries.
There are lots of painters sketching in town.
You're fond of the museum, then?
Yes, I am. I go almost every day.
I never get tired of looking.
